description: Provenance manifest for the Qinari 0.2.0 golden reference corpus (plan P0-4 part 1, acquisition). Statistics extraction, golden JSON, and the `qinari verify` subcommand land later in Fase A. The audio itself NEVER enters the repository (plan 6.1 / 10.F): files live under /home/z/my-project/work/corpus/<category>/ outside the git tree, and only this manifest is commit-ready.

policy.purpose: offline extraction of reference statistics (LTAS, C/C1/C2, event distributions, interaural features) into committed golden JSON; not shipped audio
policy.source: Freesound public sound pages (https://freesound.org). The API requires a key that was not available (HTTP 401 verified 2026-11-08), so each sound's public HTML page was fetched and the license verified per file from that page (CC0 label + creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero URL); the file stored is the page's hq preview mp3 from cdn.freesound.org.
policy.license_rule: CC0 1.0 dedication only (public-domain dedication would also be acceptable). CC-BY, CC-BY-NC and every other license were rejected for these targets. Every row's license was verified on its source page this session; licenses: 100% CC0 1.0.
policy.file_policy: hq preview mp3 as served by cdn.freesound.org (~128-160 kbps, 32/44.1/48 kHz as served); preferred sources whose preview is <= 2 MB; longer previews trimmed to 100 s with `ffmpeg -t 100 -c copy` (per-row `notes`); no other processing, no normalization, no re-encode.
policy.independence_rule: at most 2 files per uploader per category (acquisition cap), to keep recordings independent within a category
policy.conditions_note: recording conditions (intensity, surface, distance) are not structured metadata on Freesound; where the author stated them they are quoted in microphone_context, otherwise it carries the page description as-is

split_rule.goal: 3-way split with no source leakage (plan 6.1 rule 2): one uploader/session never appears in two subsets, and pieces of one file count as one source
split_rule.algorithm: subset(uploader) = bucket of sha256('qinari-corpus-split-v1|' + seed + '|' + uploader): take the first 16 hex chars (64 bits) as an integer, divide by 2^64 for a uniform u in [0,1); u < 0.60 -> train, u < 0.80 -> validation, else hold-out
split_rule.unit: uploader, globally across categories (not per category): 4 uploaders contribute to two categories each, and one sound (fs_477342) is deliberately listed under both rain and wind; hashing the uploader alone guarantees all of an uploader's files - including both copies of fs_477342 - land in the same subset
split_rule.seed_selection: the seed is a fixed recorded string, chosen from a short list of mnemonic candidates as the one whose split keeps every category non-empty in all three subsets while landing closest to the 60/20/20 target; it never changes after this recording
split_rule.verifier: tools/split_rule.py (stdlib only) recomputes the split from this manifest and fails on any deviation

known_caveats: fs_477342 ('Semi-urban ambience_2', uploader josephvm) is intentionally listed under both rain and wind: its page description states wind and light drizzle in one recording. Both rows are byte-identical copies of the same source and are assigned the same subset by the uploader-global split rule, so no subset sees it twice in different roles. rain and wind each hold 11 other independent recordings.

impact currently holds 12 metal, 4 wood, 4 ceramic files (20 total, the category ceiling of the 10-20 band). Wood and ceramic are below the 10-recording independence band on their own; they enter as material subgroups of the impact category, and per-material golden gates must wait until each material reaches >= 10 recordings (plan 6.1 sizing rule).

4 uploaders contribute to two categories each: ValentinPetiteau (impact/wind), ahriik (fire/wind), florianreichelt (stream/wind), josephvm (rain/wind), kyles (impact/wind). The uploader-global split rule keeps every uploader in exactly one subset.
9 of 104 files are trimmed 100 s excerpts of longer hq previews (see per-file notes); the excerpt shares the source's subset because the split unit is the uploader.
One impact file (fs_634147, 1.3 s) is at the 0.8 s acceptance floor for one-shots; kept because ceramic CC0 material is scarce.

files.microphone_context: General Ambience of Brood X Cicadas in Northern Virginia, recorded on a small street with wind and birds in the background. Recorded with a Zoom H1n in 2021.
